name: dsir-ghe
description: Discover and retrieve WHO Global Health Estimates with exact countries, causes, years, sex, age, measures, units and provenance.

interface.longDescription: Discover WHO Global Health Estimates causes, measures and dimensions. Retrieve mortality and disease-burden estimates by country, year, sex, age and exact cause codes, with units, uncertainty fields when available, completeness checks and source provenance. Export CSV and JSON for further analysis. Includes a verified WHO country-code mapping. All-age rates are crude; selected-age rates are age-specific. The tool does not automatically age-standardize rates or sum overlapping cause categories. Runs in ChatGPT Work using the host's script environment and public HTTPS access. Users do not install R, DSIR or additional packages, and no API key is needed. Independently maintained by Shanlong Ding; it does not provide clinical advice.
defaultPrompt: Get all-cause deaths in the Philippines for the latest available year.
Compare female and male mortality rates at ages 40-44 in the Philippines.
Find available GHE causes and measures for diabetes.

review.commerce_description: The plugin is free and does not sell products, offer purchases or process payments. AI host subscriptions are separate.
prompts: Get all-cause deaths and the crude death rate in the Philippines for 2023, both sexes and all ages. Export CSV and JSON.
Find available GHE causes and measures for diabetes before retrieving data.
Compare female and male mortality rates at ages 40-44 in the Philippines for 2023.
List the built-in WHO country mapping for the Western Pacific Region.
Can I sum parent and child cause categories or average age-specific rates to obtain an age-standardized rate?

publication.release_notes: Initial independent GHE plugin with built-in WHO country mapping, exact cause and dimension discovery, bounded public WHO retrieval, completeness and data-quality checks, and CSV/JSON exports. Distinguish crude and age-specific rates and prevent unsupported aggregation.
